statement: The site Lambda (open-university-web), its IAM role and its CloudFront front door are defined outside this repository's IaC stacks, and D-346 retired the runner-based canary alert and image rollback with no live synthetic canary replacing them; infrastructure drift or a broken deploy on the live site path has no IaC test or automated rollback.

treatment.plan: Approved by D-352 (Torre por delegação do Daniel 22/11/2026) as future work: import the site Lambda (open-university-web), its IAM role and its CloudFront distribution into infra/aws/stacks/ via CloudFormation import (without replacing resources) with stack tests, and install a read-only post-deploy HTTP synthetic canary over the live site URL via a separate workflow PR for the Torre to install (D-087). Stays assessed until implemented.
